first_fault_bounds.proof: Actual acquire/adopt occur once per main; sticky fault prevents further native commit/seal/consume after their first failure; unlock is one finally for that commit; one final end; one ordered publication. First error object + caught TB precede strings/deferred/renderer. New unexpected repetition never overwrites earlier cell, original is explicit cause of a refusal; no replay.
first_fault_bounds.aliases: Exact BaseException pointer retains original args/native attributes/cause/context/group/state aliases; separate caught traceback pointer remains primary. This is LOCAL Python ownership, not full original stock/native/private body or outside physical receiver.
first_fault_bounds.secondary: Independent unlock/end/publication cells never replace commit or original prefix/encoding failure slots. Partial native append/late frame remains unresolved body state, never retried.
first_fault_bounds.representation: Only reached phase rows published (1..8), full existing v2 graph required at both real recursive decoders. Beyond/reason-only marker cannot qualify the outside relation. Existing PO880/FR875 grammar and complete raw reservations unchanged.
first_fault_bounds.positive: No new outside errors field on error-free path; no blanket false on ordinary success. Both receivers keep original caps/schema/roundtrip, all original six meaningful scenarios required.
